# GameOn agent API

GameOn is a REST API for discovering, creating, joining, and managing local sports games.

## Canonical endpoints

- Base URL: https://gameonsite.com/api/v1
- OpenAPI: https://gameonsite.com/api/v1/openapi
- Identity check: GET /api/v1/me
- Public discovery: GET /api/v1/games
- Personal games: GET /api/v1/me/games
- Game detail: GET /api/v1/games/{id}

## Authentication

Public discovery, game detail, and participant listing can be called without authentication where the game visibility rules allow it.

All writes and personal endpoints require:

Authorization: Bearer <Supabase access token>

Use the token of the GameOn user whose games should be read or modified. Do not put credentials in URLs.

## Mutations

- POST /games — create
- PATCH /games/{id} — update a hosted game
- DELETE /games/{id} — cancel
- POST /games/{id}/join — join/request to join
- DELETE /games/{id}/join — leave
- POST /games/{id}/join-requests/{requestId}/approve — approve
- POST /games/{id}/join-requests/{requestId}/reject — reject

Send an Idempotency-Key header on POST/PATCH mutations. The API replays identical requests and rejects reuse with a different body.

## Agent behavior

1. Discover the API from the OpenAPI document rather than guessing fields.
2. Call GET /me before acting on behalf of a user.
3. Use GET /games for public discovery and GET /me/games for the user's games.
4. Confirm the target game with GET /games/{id} before consequential mutations when the user's intent is ambiguous.
5. Use stable error.code values for branching and use details.action for the recommended recovery step. Validation errors expose details.issues with field paths and messages.
6. Preserve requestId when reporting failures so server-side logs can be correlated.
6. Never expose private share tokens or contact details unless the API explicitly returns them to an authorized caller.
7. Treat cancellation, leaving, and rejection as destructive actions and obtain user confirmation when the surrounding agent policy requires it.

## Pagination

GET /games uses cursor pagination. Continue with pagination.nextCursor until hasMore is false.

## Rate limits

Responses include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset. HTTP 429 includes Retry-After.

## Important compatibility note

This REST surface is designed for OpenAPI-capable agents and custom connectors. A hosted MCP endpoint is a separate transport and is not implied by the REST/OpenAPI URL.
